prompt:
Create a native high fidelity illustrated game sprite atlas of THE FURY, original Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater, original 2004 PlayStation 2 incarnation, using the supplied actual original reference images. This is a faithful costume/equipment adaptation, not Delta. Output native transparent RGBA PNG, no background. Exactly TWELVE entirely separate complete full-body figures, on a FOUR COLUMN by THREE ROW evenly spaced grid, read left to right top to bottom. Each figure fits wholly within its cell with 40 pixels of empty alpha between figures and 30 pixels at outer image edges. Prefer wide 1536 x 1024 sheet. All figures face screen LEFT, fixed orthographic side / three-quarter fighting-game projection, same design and same standing body scale, clean detailed hand-painted 2D sprite art, restrained neutral material palette. No text labels, no cell lines, no shadows, no detached equipment or extra persons.

Original FURY identity must follow Konami model and actual PS2 captures: black/dark charcoal ribbed padded Soviet cosmonaut suit, copper/bronze-dark rounded closed helmet and visor with the original three Cyrillic characters БЕЙ across its front, face hidden beneath closed reflective visor (no exposed face, no modern visor greebles). Broad high charcoal neck seal, very thin restrained bronze seam accents, closed black gloves, padded black trousers and original angular heavy black high boots. Compact paired PALE BEIGE/GREY vertical tanks attached to his BACK; original thin black transverse triangular booms extend behind shoulder plane with small outer jet nozzles, as real 21845/21885s capture. These are not mechanical wings and not body armor. Original long tubular black flamethrower in ANATOMICAL RIGHT hand with rear trigger grip, simple forward barrel muzzle and a hose that stays connected to the BACK tank. Left hand can support tube but never hold a second gun. Never exchange right/left anatomy; actual right-hand grip remains anatomical right when three-quarter view changes. No camouflage, no bare face, no NASA patch, no rifle stock, no glowing tubes. No flames, thruster exhaust, aura, smoke, projectiles, scenery or particles baked into body figures. Tank and weapon remain attached to one figure, every hose connected and NOT touching adjacent figures.

This sheet C has EXACTLY twelve isolated full-body figures, four columns by three rows, same body scale, all facing screen LEFT.
TOP ROW four poses: 0 flamethrower windup, feet braced and right hand on trigger, left glove supporting the tube, muzzle moving from low position to waist level; 1 ACTIVE flamethrower aim, slight knee brace, barrel held HORIZONTAL toward LEFT at WAIST level with anatomy right trigger hand and left support, visible original OPEN END of barrel, no actual flame or projectile; 2 fire recovery lower tube slightly and relieve trigger; 3 floor-fire deployment windup crouch and aim flamethrower barrel downward forward.
MIDDLE ROW four poses: 4 ACTIVE floor-fire deployment, visibly crouched knees and original connected flamethrower nozzle pointed DOWN-LEFT diagonally nearly toward ground at ankle height but still inside cell, nozzle visible and no actual fire or detached device; 5 floor-fire recovery lifting the barrel back low across torso; 6 physical grab startup left open glove reaching toward LEFT while right glove carries original weapon down; 7 physical grab ACTIVE left open glove extended toward LEFT with low stance, one whole figure and no opponent, flamethrower stays lowered right hand; 
BOTTOM ROW four poses: 8 grapple recovery left hand drawing back and body rising; 9 cooling/recovery pause chest relaxed, tube lowered right hand; 10 cooling/repair ACTIVE left glove gently resting on hose coupling beside torso while gun remains lowered right hand, bounded equipment cooling not healing; 11 recovery finishing pause with left glove returning to chest and tube low.
No detached devices in deployment. Floor fire comes from original flame nozzle, not planted mine. No bare face, no unhelmeted man, no fiery eyes, no flame/aura/puffs baked into any body sprite, no jet exhaust. Use A LEFT as same identity/costume guide, match original PS2/Konami gun, bronze closed helmet and black ribbed suit with beige BACK tanks and original nozzle boom. True transparent alpha backdrop and wide isolation margins.
Draw all TWELVE figures facing LEFT, use supplied A LEFT as the orientation guide. This is a fresh independently drawn opposite view, not a mirrored original. БЕЙ stays readable. Flamethrower remains anatomical RIGHT hand, not switched left, both-support hand on tube. C1 active nozzle points HORIZONTAL LEFT; C4 active low-deployment nozzle points DOWN-LEFT nearly toward floor; C7 open anatomical LEFT hand grabs toward LEFT. Backpack stays behind body toward RIGHT and helmet front faces LEFT in every cell. Preserve existing true alpha and keep all figures/hoses complete and separated.
